subject.title: [Bug]: Matrix message read/pins CLI output renders completely blank tables

question: Should the linked Matrix fix return a deduplicated edited-message view to all readMessages JSON/tool consumers, or keep m.replace collapse display-only while fixing the blank CLI table?
rationale: The blank table bug is concrete, but the active fix also changes structured Matrix read payload semantics, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept Edited-Message Payloads
options.body: Merge the linked PR if maintainers want Matrix read output to expose the final edited-message view consistently across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

options.title: Keep Collapse Display-Only
options.body: Ask for m.replace collapse to move into the display/projection layer while preserving raw timeline-style readMessages payloads.

options.title: Split The Fix
options.body: Land the formatter field projection first and defer payload-level edit deduplication to a focused follow-up.

recommendation.title: Accept Edited-Message Payloads
recommendation.body: Merge the linked PR if maintainers want Matrix read output to expose the final edited-message view consistently across CLI, JSON, and tool consumers.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest Matrix plugin and message-action boundary history for this payload contract decision.
